title: release-revision
responsibility: Read the full Git commit of a clean tracked worktree for the desktop release stamp and validate revision values.

inputs.name: releaseRevision.cwd
inputs.description: Git working directory to inspect. The default is the current directory.

inputs.name: isRevision.value
inputs.unknownReason: The guard accepts any value and determines whether it is a valid revision string.

outputs.name: releaseRevision
outputs.description: Full lowercase Git commit hash for the clean tracked worktree.

outputs.name: isRevision
outputs.description: True when the value is a 40-character lowercase hexadecimal string.

errors.name: MacPackageError
errors.description: Git cannot read the commit or worktree status, HEAD is not a valid revision, or the worktree has tracked changes.
